pages.brief: Wide, bleached-bright summer scene: a farm field under a huge white-hot sky, heat shimmer over the stubble. Almost too bright to look at.
pages.alt: A wide, bleached-bright summer scene over a farm field under a huge white-hot sun, the light almost too bright to look at.

pages.brief: Pip and Ned running side by side through the field, wings and flippers out, pure joy. Grass seeds flying up around them.
pages.alt: Pip and Ned run side by side through the field, wings and flippers out in pure joy, grass seeds flying up around them.

pages.brief: A tall stack of golden hay bales, Ned scrambling up the side with his feet slipping on the loose straw. Big warm gold shapes.
pages.alt: A tall stack of golden hay bales, with Ned scrambling up the side, his feet slipping on the loose straw.

pages.brief: Pip sunk deep into loose hay at the top of the stack with just his head and tuft showing, blissful. Fine straw detail.
pages.alt: Pip is sunk deep into loose hay at the top of the stack with just his head and tuft showing, blissful.

pages.brief: Ned launching into a shallow blue paddling pool with all four limbs out, water leaping up in a crown shape. Peak duckling.
pages.alt: Ned launches into a shallow blue paddling pool with all four limbs out, water leaping up in a crown shape.

pages.brief: The wave of water arriving at Pip, who is caught mid-flinch with one wing up. Ned in the pool grinning. Comic timing.
pages.alt: A wave of water arrives at Pip, who flinches with one wing up, while Ned grins in the pool. Comic timing.

pages.brief: Pip stalking away from the pool with wet, spiky, indignant feathers, tail up. Ned's splashes still going on behind him.
pages.alt: Pip stalks away from the pool with wet, spiky, indignant feathers and his tail up, Ned's splashes still going on behind him.

pages.brief: Pip settled in deep cool shade under a broad leafy bush, seen from outside so the shade is a rich dark green pocket in a blazing page.
pages.alt: Pip settles into the deep cool shade under a broad leafy bush, a rich dark green pocket in an otherwise blazing-bright page.

pages.brief: Closing page: both of them flat on their backs in the shade at end of day, exhausted and happy, the sun going low and orange over the field.
pages.alt: Closing page: Pip and Ned lie flat on their backs in the shade at the end of the day, exhausted and happy, as the sun goes low and orange over the field.
